title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 6
subtitle: Will It Float?
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 6: Will It Float? (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, thanks for taking me on a tour of D.C. today.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，謝謝你今天帶我遊覽華盛頓特區。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure thing, Penelope. You are new to town. And a tour is the best way to see more of the city!
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，佩內洛普。你剛到這座城市。遊覽是多看這座城市最好的辦法！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: So, which tour are we taking – the one that goes through the city on a bus? Or the one that goes along the river in a boat?
dialogue.zh: 那我們參加哪個遊覽——坐巴士穿過城市的那個？還是坐船沿河走的那個？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Both!
dialogue.zh: 兩個都要！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: What? Anna, this isn’t going to be one of those trips, is it?
dialogue.zh: 什麼？安娜，這不會又是那種行程吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. Follow me.
dialogue.zh: 不是。跟我來。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: In this lesson, you are going to hear lots of prepositions! What’s a preposition, you ask? It’s a word that shows relationships between things. Anna says they are going on a tour through the city and along the river. Through and along are both prepositions. Watch for more!
dialogue.zh: 這一課你會聽到很多介詞！介詞是什麼？它是表示事物之間關係的詞。安娜說她們要參加穿過城市、沿著河邊的遊覽。through 和 along 都是介詞。繼續找更多！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, Penelope, there’s our ride!
dialogue.zh: 佩內洛普，那就是我們的車！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: What is it?
dialogue.zh: 那是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s the famous DC Ducks -- the boat with wheels! We will ride on the road and then sail on the water!
dialogue.zh: 是著名的 DC Ducks——帶輪子的船！我們先在路上開，再在水上航行！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Who thinks of these things?
dialogue.zh: 誰會想出這種東西來？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't know. But I’m glad they do! Let’s get aboard, Sailor!
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。不過我很高興有人想出來！上船吧，水手！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: (looking at a brochure about the boat) Hey, did you know that this bus … um, boat was created during World War II to carry people and supplies?
dialogue.zh: （看著關於這艘船的手冊）嘿，你知道這輛巴士……呃，這艘船是二戰時造來運人和物資的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow. You know, a tour is so much more interesting with Fun Facts, like that one.
dialogue.zh: 哇。有這樣的趣聞，遊覽就有趣多了。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I agree. I love Fun Facts!
dialogue.zh: 我同意。我超愛趣聞！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Did I hear you say you love Fun Facts?
dialogue.zh: 我是不是聽到你們說喜歡趣聞？

dialogue.speaker: Anna & Penelope
dialogue.en: Yeah.
dialogue.zh: 對啊。

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Well, I have tons of Fun Facts for this tour!
dialogue.zh: 這次遊覽我有超多趣聞！

dialogue.speaker: Anna & Penelope
dialogue.en: Great!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, where are his parents?
dialogue.zh: 佩內洛普，他父母在哪兒？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Maybe - maybe he’s the Captain’s son and he helps his dad on tours!
dialogue.zh: 也許——也許他是船長的兒子，幫爸爸做遊覽！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh yeah! It would be so awesome to ride around the city in a boat all day with your dad!
dialogue.zh: 對哦！整天和爸爸坐船在城裡轉，也太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: This is amazing, Anna. There are so many beautiful buildings along this road!
dialogue.zh: 太美了，安娜。這條路兩邊有好多漂亮的建築！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey, the Washington Monument is on the left!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，華盛頓紀念碑在左邊！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I have a Fun Fact too! Did you know that the Washington Monument was damaged in an earthquake? Whoa. Did you feel that?! I heard: "around the city in a boat," "along this road" and "on the left." All of these are prepositions showing place. Let's watch for more places and prepositions!
dialogue.zh: 我也有一條趣聞！你知道華盛頓紀念碑在地震中受損過嗎？哇。你感覺到了嗎？！我聽到了：around the city in a boat、along this road 和 on the left。這些都是表示地點的介詞。再找更多地點和介詞！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Look, Anna, we’re across from the White House!
dialogue.zh: 看，安娜，我們在白宮對面！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, the only thing between us and the President is the street … and a park … and a security gate .... and police officers … with guns.
dialogue.zh: 佩內洛普，我們和總統之間只隔著這條街……還有一座公園……還有安檢門……還有警察……帶著槍。

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Excuse me, do you want to know a Fun Fact about the White House?
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，想聽一條關於白宮的趣聞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna & Penelope
dialogue.en: Yes!
dialogue.zh: 想！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Inside the White House there is a swimming pool, a movie theater and 32 bathrooms!
dialogue.zh: 白宮裡面有一個游泳池、一個電影院，還有 32 間浴室！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Thirty-two bathrooms! That’s a lot of bathrooms!
dialogue.zh: 三十二間浴室！也太多了！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: I’d be happy with two. I live in a house with my mom, four sisters, two aunts and only one bathroom!
dialogue.zh: 有兩間我就滿足了。我和媽媽、四個姐姐、兩個阿姨住在一起，卻只有一間浴室！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Oh my! You know, Anna, we should give him a tip!
dialogue.zh: 天哪！安娜，我們應該給他小費！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Of course! It is polite to tip your tour guide! Luckily, I have lots of dollar bills!
dialogue.zh: 當然！給導遊小費是禮貌！幸好我帶了很多美元鈔票！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: That was a great Fun Fact! Here you go!
dialogue.zh: 這條趣聞太棒了！給你！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Thank you! I can tell you Fun Facts all day!
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！我可以給你們講一整天趣聞！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you hear any more prepositions of place? I heard "between us and the president," "inside the White House" and "in a house." And did you hear that the Duck Boat can go on the river? I don't believe it. Join us next time to find out which preposition we will use: The boat went ON the river or The boat went INTO the river?
dialogue.zh: 你還聽到更多地點介詞了嗎？我聽到了 between us and the president、inside the White House 和 in a house。你聽到鴨子船能開到河上嗎？我不信。下次再看我們用哪個介詞：The boat went ON the river，還是 The boat went INTO the river？

quiz.prompt: What kind of tour do Anna and Penelope take?
choices: The DC Ducks — a boat with wheels
A walking tour of the White House

quiz.prompt: What Fun Fact does the boy give about the White House?
choices: It is across from Union Station

quiz.prompt: Why do Anna and Penelope give the boy money?
choices: He is the captain of the boat
It is polite to tip your tour guide
